name.en-US: Thoughts of the Curé of Ars

author.en-US: St. John Vianney, the Curé of Ars
author.pt-BR: São João Maria Vianney, o Cura d’Ars

description.en-US: A twelve-chapter anthology of sayings drawn from Monnin’s Esprit du Curé d’Ars: salvation, the love of God, the pure soul, the Holy Spirit, prayer, the priest, the Eucharist, sin, hell, suffering and heaven.
description.pt-BR: Antologia em doze capítulos de ditos do Cura d’Ars tirados do Esprit de Monnin: salvação, amor de Deus, alma pura, Espírito Santo, oração, sacerdote, Eucaristia, pecado, inferno, sofrimento e céu.

sources.edition: Thoughts of the Curé of Ars, Boston, Flynn & Mahony, 1896 (OCR; preface signed A. Mennin [Monnin])
sources.description: Anthology of sayings taken from the Esprit du Curé d’Ars; the translator is not named.
